Wake me in my hunting areas
When you arrive in an area with Wake me here on, Doorprints offers Hunt mode, usually within a few minutes. Needs location allowed all the time.
Why: so Doorprints notices when you arrive in an area you are searching and offers Hunt mode. It never starts Hunt mode by itself.
How: Google Play services compares where the phone is with your areas, on the phone. Doorprints keeps no location history and sends your position nowhere.
Battery: small. Doorprints asks for no location of its own.
To stop it, turn off Wake me in my hunting areas in My areas, or take the location permission away in the phone's settings.
